description: This file implements a Google Calendar service class with methods for creating, updating, deleting, and fetching calendar events and availability, including handling of recurring events, attendees, and calendar listing. It also defines interfaces for Google-specific calendar operations and utility functions.

classes.name: GoogleCalendar
classes.description: Extended interface for Google Calendar with Google-specific methods such as getPrimaryCalendar, upsertSelectedCalendar, createSelectedCalendar, and authedCalendar.

classes.name: GoogleCalError
classes.description: Custom error interface extending Error with an optional code property.

classes.name: GoogleCalendarService
classes.description: Implements the Calendar interface, providing methods to interact with Google Calendar API including event management, calendar listing, availability fetching, and credential validation.

methods.name: isGoogleSystemCalendar
methods.description: Checks if a given calendar ID ends with known suffixes for Google system calendars that do not return proper free/busy info.

methods.name: getReminderDuration
methods.description: Retrieves custom reminder duration for a given credential ID from the destination calendar repository.

methods.name: getReminders
methods.description: Returns reminder configuration object based on custom reminder minutes.

methods.name: getCredentialId
methods.description: Returns the credential ID associated with the service instance.

methods.name: authedCalendar
methods.description: Returns an authenticated Google Calendar client.

methods.name: getAttendees
methods.description: Generates a list of attendees for an event, including handling of organizer, external calendar, and team members.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event in Google Calendar, handling recurring events, conference data, and hangout links.

methods.name: getFirstEventInRecurrence
methods.description: Fetches the first instance of a recurring event by recurring event ID.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event in Google Calendar, including handling of hangout links and conference data.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event from Google Calendar, with error handling for already deleted or missing events.

methods.name: fetchAvailability
methods.description: Queries Google Calendar free/busy API for availability data.

methods.name: getFreeBusyResult
methods.description: Wrapper for fetchAvailability to get free/busy data.

methods.name: getValidCalendars
methods.description: Filters calendar list entries to only include those with valid IDs.

methods.name: filterPrimaryCalendar
methods.description: Selects the primary calendar from a list, or defaults to the first.

methods.name: getFreeBusyData
methods.description: Converts free/busy API response into an array of busy date ranges.

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Retrieves busy times for selected calendars within a date range.

methods.name: listCalendars
methods.description: Lists all user calendars, filtering out system calendars.

methods.name: testDelegationCredentialSetup
methods.description: Tests if the delegated credentials have proper access to Google Calendar.

methods.name: createSelectedCalendar
methods.description: Creates a selected calendar record in the database.

methods.name: upsertSelectedCalendar
methods.description: Updates or inserts a selected calendar record.

methods.name: upsertSelectedCalendarsForEventTypeIds
methods.description: Bulk upsert of selected calendars for specific event type IDs.

methods.name: getAllCalendars
methods.description: Fetches all calendars with pagination.

methods.name: getPrimaryCalendar
methods.description: Fetches the primary calendar details.

methods.name: getMainTimeZone
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone of the primary calendar.
